ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent Medicaid fraud investigation in Minnesota and follow the money to uncover the extent of the fraud and those involved.
questions: Who is behind the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to fraudulent activities?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. I recommend starting with the recent investigation and following the money to uncover the extent of the fraud.
